2</SUP> Wheaton International previously entered into a silver purchase agreement with Mercator
Minerals Ltd. (“Mercator”) in respect of the Mineral Park mine. In 2014, Mercator was deemed to have filed an assignment in bankruptcy in Canada and certain Mercator’s subsidiaries (including Mineral Park Inc. the owner of the
Mineral Park mine) filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy petitions in the United States.
